description: Navigation, application structure, branding and icons

rows.feature: Direct link to a table list renders seeded rows
scenarios: success

rows.feature: Sidebar lists every permitted top-level app once, by label, in backend order, with nested apps only under their parent
rows.fixture: stock sample apps + NavigationFixtures (Nav Level One, Nav Empty App); persona noPets
scenarios: admin sees Miscellaneous, Nav Empty App, Nav Level One, People App, Sample Widgets Dashboard, Sharing Demo in backend order
Greetings App appears only under People App (regression: it was duplicated at top level)
group children use metadata labels
negative: noPets persona: Pet and Pet Note are absent from the sidebar; backend returns 404 for their metadata and 403 for a query

rows.feature: Apps nested deeper than two levels render as nested sidebar groups; deep links expand every enclosing group
scenarios: expand three nested groups and open Nav Deep Item; grid rows match nav_deep_item
deep link to /app/navDeepItem expands all three groups and marks the item current

rows.feature: Sidebar click navigation to app homes, tables and processes with active-entry highlighting and collapse/expand
scenarios: Dashboard is current on /app
click app, table, process; URL, content and aria-current follow
collapse hides children, expand shows them

rows.feature: Declared icons (QIcon name, color, path) render on navigation surfaces
rows.fixture: sample icons (stars, person, widgets, share, pets, local_shipping, badge) + NavigationFixtures (path icon, colored icon, inventory_2, inbox, layers)
scenarios: sidebar glyph per declared Material name, color applied, image path loads
app home entries and section headings show declared icons
command palette entries show declared icons
negative: no declared icon renders the type fallback glyph

rows.feature: Hidden tables and processes never appear in navigation; direct links to hidden objects the user may not access show not-found and the backend denies them
rows.fixture: sample city (hidden table), greet and simpleSleep (hidden processes); NavigationFixtures navHiddenNote (hidden, NOT_PROTECTED)
scenarios: sidebar, app home, landing page and command palette omit City, Greet People, Simple Sleep and Nav Hidden Note
negative: /app/city and /app/greet show the not-found state; backend returns 404 and 403

rows.feature: A hidden table the user may access opens by direct link (hidden is not denied)
source: qqq-backend-core/.../actions/metadata/MetaDataAction.java (hidden but permitted objects are returned with isHidden)
scenarios: /app/navHiddenNote lists nav_hidden_note rows; breadcrumbs show its enclosing apps

rows.feature: App home sections list processes (Actions), reports (Reports) and tables (Data) by label with icons, and each entry navigates
scenarios: Miscellaneous: Actions Sleep Interactive, Simple Throw; Data Carrier, Field Lab, Pet Species (labels, not names)
section heading shows its label and declared icon
clicking an entry opens the table or process
negative: hidden or unpermitted section entries are omitted (navHiddenNote, noPets persona)

rows.feature: App home table entries show the backend record count
rows.fixture: sample carrier, fieldLab, petSpecies, person, pet, petNote rows
scenarios: each Data entry reads 'N total records' equal to the SQL count

rows.feature: App homes of apps with child apps, only processes, or nothing render without errors
rows.fixture: sample peopleApp; NavigationFixtures navLevelOne, navEmptyApp; persona viewer
scenarios: People App shows Clone People and the Greetings App child app (regression: crashed on missing widgets)
Nav Level One lists its child app and navigates to it
Nav Empty App shows the empty state
negative: viewer persona: People App shows only the Greetings App child app (no denied process)

rows.feature: A dashboard app (widgets only) opens from navigation and shows one labelled container per permitted declared widget
scenarios: sidebar click opens the dashboard; one widget region per declared widget label, in order

rows.feature: Branding: sidebar logo (Material parity), app name, favicon from the icon, accent color, and partial branding accepted without warnings
rows.fixture: sample branding (appName, logo /samples-logo.png, icon /kr-icon.png) + NavigationFixtures accentColor #1d4ed8
scenarios: sidebar shows /samples-logo.png with alt QQQ Sample, loaded, linking to the dashboard
favicon link points to /kr-icon.png
primary color variables equal the branding accent color
no 'schema validation' console warning for branding without companyName/companyUrl

rows.feature: Branding banners render in their slots (top of site, top of body, side nav under logo) with text or sanitized HTML, severity and colors
rows.fixture: NavigationFixtures banners: QFMD_TOP_OF_SITE (INFO text), QFMD_TOP_OF_BODY (WARNING HTML), QFMD_SIDE_NAV_UNDER_LOGO (SUCCESS, colors, additional styles)
scenarios: each slot shows its message in the right place with severity and colors from metadata
negative: unknown slots are not rendered

rows.feature: Breadcrumbs show the full app hierarchy for tables, processes, records, create and edit pages, and each crumb navigates
scenarios: /app/person: People App / Greetings App / Person
/app/navDeepItem/2/edit: Nav Level One / Nav Level Two / Nav Level Three / Nav Deep Item / 2 / Edit
process and create pages
clicking a crumb opens that app home
negative: no breadcrumbs on the dashboard root

rows.feature: Document title names the page, its enclosing apps and the application (Material parity)
scenarios: Dashboard | QQQ Sample; Person | Greetings App | People App | QQQ Sample; record label title on the record page
negative: unknown route title is Not Found | QQQ Sample

rows.feature: The site root redirects to the dashboard
scenarios: / replaces itself with /app (back does not return to /)

rows.feature: Dashboard landing page: counts, quick actions and application cards derived from navigable, permitted metadata by label
scenarios: counts equal the navigable tables, processes, apps and their widgets from backend metadata
quick actions create only navigable insertable tables and run only navigable processes, by label (regression: listed internal and table-bulk processes, crashed on apps without widgets)
application cards open app homes
negative: viewer persona: no create or process quick actions

rows.feature: Direct (hard-loaded) links open every route shape with the shell, sidebar state and breadcrumbs
scenarios: app home, nested app home, table, process, record view, record edit, create, saved view

rows.feature: Browser refresh keeps the route, its query string and the rendered content
scenarios: refresh on a table with a query string, a record view, and an app home

rows.feature: Browser back and forward traverse navigation history with the right content
scenarios: dashboard > app home > table > record, then back three times and forward twice

rows.feature: An unknown /app/{name} shows an in-shell not-found state with a link to the dashboard
scenarios: /app/noSuchThing shows 'Page not found' naming the segment; the link opens the dashboard; no failed requests

rows.feature: Unknown deeper or top-level paths return the 404 page with a working home link
scenarios: /app/person/1/no/such and /no-such-page respond 404 and render the 404 page; Go Home reaches the dashboard
negative: only the document 404 is reported

rows.feature: Record lookup by key: /app/{table}/key?{field}={value} opens the single matching record
rows.fixture: NavigationFixtures navDeepItem (unique key code); sample person emails
scenarios: ?code=NAV-B2 opens record 2 (Tide Chart); ?email=... opens that person
negative: no match, several matches (?shelf=North), unknown field, no parameters: error message, no navigation

rows.feature: Command palette (Ctrl+K and '.') lists navigable apps, tables and processes by label with type and app context, filters, and navigates by keyboard
scenarios: filter 'pet' shows Pet, Pet Note, Pet Species with type and app; Enter opens the first
'.' opens the palette; Escape closes it
negative: hidden objects are not listed

rows.feature: Header search, '/' search dialog and search page jump to navigation targets and recently viewed records by label (matched locally, alongside record search when the backend offers it: NAV-030)
scenarios: typing a label lists matching pages with app context; choosing one navigates
a viewed record is offered as a recent record
Enter without a selection opens /app/search?q= with the matches, surviving refresh
negative: no search request fails (regression: every keystroke produced a 404 from a missing /search endpoint); with no searchable tables no request is made at all (NAV-032)

rows.feature: Mobile navigation drawer opens from the header, navigates and closes
scenarios: hamburger opens the drawer; choosing a table navigates and closes it; close button closes it

rows.feature: Developer page reports the backend metadata counts and the running framework versions
scenarios: metadata counts equal the backend's; framework shows the bundled Next.js version (regression: hardcoded 'Next.js 15')

rows.feature: Reports in the app tree are listed under their app (sidebar and app home Reports group) and open the report page
source: src/lib/api/metadata.ts (v1 omits reports; merged from the full metadata)
rows.fixture: NavigationFixtures navDeepItemReport (child of Nav Level Three, icon assessment)
scenarios: sidebar entry with its icon opens /app/navDeepItemReport with the report heading, title and breadcrumbs
app home Reports group lists and opens it

rows.feature: A user who may access no apps sees the Dashboard entry and the no-apps message (Material NoApps parity)
rows.fixture: harness persona noApps (every permission except App HAS_ACCESS) - requested: not yet in AcceptanceSampleServer
scenarios: sidebar shows only Dashboard; landing shows You do not have permission to access any apps.
negative: app home links show the not-found state

rows.feature: Global search (header box, '/' dialog, search page) lists the records a backend record search (POST /qqq/v1/search over each table's searchFields) finds, after the matching pages, by record label with the table label; results open by keyboard and the search page survives refresh
rows.fixture: stock sample + NavigationFixtures (search fields on person, pet, savedView)
scenarios: '/' dialog: 'COCO' finds the pet Coco (label and table label), case-insensitively; ArrowDown and Enter open /app/pet/{id}
the request searches the readable searchable tables (person, pet, savedView) with a per-table limit of 5

header box: 'Sample' lists the matching people (database order, limit 5) after pages; Enter opens /app/search?q=Sample whose Records region lists every match (limit 25) before and after refresh; a link opens the record
negative: a one-character term is not sent (unit), and a recent record already found is not listed twice (unit)

rows.feature: Record search respects table read permissions and record security locks, in the UI and the API
source: qqq-backend-core RecordSearchAction (PermissionsHelper READ, QueryAction record locks), QFrontendTableMetaData.searchFields
rows.fixture: stock sample + NavigationFixtures + QueryFixtures (alice's saved view shared read-only with bob); noPets persona; sharing demo users
scenarios: noPets: 'ey' lists the matching people only; the UI never asks for pets and the metadata advertises no pet search fields
admin: the backend returns the pets matching 'EY' for tableNames [pet]
alice finds her saved view 'Alice People View' with the saved view table label, in the UI and from the API
bob, with whom the view is shared read-only, finds it from the API (the lock admits shared readers)
negative: noPets: POST /qqq/v1/search with tableNames [pet] returns no results; an unscoped search returns no pets
casey (neither owner nor shared reader): the locked saved view is not found in the UI or from the API

rows.feature: Without searchable tables (the backend declares no searchFields) global search stays local and never calls a search endpoint
scenarios: the variant's v1 metadata lists no table with searchFields
header box, '/' dialog and search page keep the local labels and matches, with no Records group or region
negative: no request to /qqq/v1/search or /search is made while typing, opening the dialog or loading the search page

rows.feature: Login branding before sign-in: logo, app name, accent color, favicon and title from GET /qqq/v1/metaData/authentication (no session), never the banners
rows.fixture: sample branding (appName, logo /samples-logo.png, icon /kr-icon.png) + NavigationFixtures accentColor #1d4ed8 and three banners
scenarios: unauthenticated authentication metadata carries exactly appName, logo, icon and accentColor
after logout and a fresh load the login card shows the loaded logo and QQQ Sample
primary color variables and the Sign in button use the accent; favicon /kr-icon.png; title Sign in | QQQ Sample
negative: no banner text in the unauthenticated response or on the login page

rows.feature: Material table-scoped URLs: /app/{table}/{process} opens the table process (or an instance process); /app/{table}/{id}/{process} runs it for that record and returns to it
source: material-dashboard src/App.tsx (table process routes), src/qqq/pages/records/view/RecordView.tsx (record process routes)
rows.fixture: sample person.bulkEdit, clonePeople (table processes), prcQuickTask (ProcessesFixtures, instance process)
scenarios: /app/person/person.bulkEdit?recordsParam=recordIds&recordIds=1,2 replaces itself with the run (init sends 1,2; Back returns to the table)
/app/person/prcQuickTask opens the instance process with returnTo the table
/app/person/1/clonePeople runs for record 1 (init and SQL clone) and Return lands on the record
/app/person/2/bulkEdit resolves the table process by suffix; Cancel returns to the record
negative: /app/person/1/noSuchProcess shows the in-shell not-found state and starts no process
report URLs (/app/{table}/{report}) are not covered: the backend frontend report metadata (QFrontendReportMetaData) has no tableName, so no report can match (#732)

rows.feature: Process runs launched from a record view or a filtered query return there (Return and Cancel honor returnTo)
source: material-dashboard src/qqq/pages/records/query/RecordQuery.tsx and RecordView.tsx (process modal over the screen)
scenarios: record Actions > Clone People runs for the record and Return lands on the record
Bulk Edit from /app/person?filter=isEmployed: returnTo is the launching path and query; after the edit (SQL) Return restores the same filter and the filtered rows
negative: the unmatched record (Morgan) stays out of the returned grid

rows.feature: Material app settings (MaterialDashboardAppMetaData): showAppLabelOnHomeScreen and includeTableCountsOnHomeScreen turned off hide the home-screen title and the table counts
rows.fixture: NavigationFixtures.java navQuietHome app (navQuietItem table) with MaterialDashboardAppMetaData(false, false)
scenarios: v1 metaData carries supplementalAppMetaData.materialDashboard for the app
The app home has no visible title (a screen-reader-only h1 remains) and the table entry shows no count
No count request is made for the table
negative: Apps without the settings keep their title and counts (Material defaults)
